MRT-1.label: Attribution survives ingestion
MRT-1.requirement: Creator, title, version and source URL are retained as structured metadata in the dataset record, not only in the body of the source file.

MRT-2.label: Provenance is recorded
MRT-2.requirement: The record identifies where the work was obtained, when it was obtained, and the licence and terms in force at the time of collection, referenced by version.

MRT-3.label: The record is producible
MRT-3.requirement: The MRT-2 record can be produced on request to the publisher or a supervisory authority without requiring the requester to identify themselves.

MRT-4.label: Attribution appears at output
MRT-4.requirement: Where the work is quoted or closely paraphrased in a generated output, it is attributed.

mrt:reservation_scope: Text and data mining carried out for the development or training of AI systems, where the conditions above are not met.
